jobs.description:
Job Description

Brooks is seeking a highly experienced Senior Trade Compliance Analyst (m/f/d)
based onsite in our Steisslingen or Tagerwilen office, to serve as the regional trade compliance expert for European Union (EU), United Kingdom (UK), and Switzerland (CH). This role is responsible for managing import and export compliance operations, customs classification, licensing, denied party screening, sanctions compliance, customs broker management, and trade system administration across the region.

The Senior Trade Compliance Analyst will act as the primary point of contact for EU/UK trade compliance matters, partnering closely with internal stakeholders, and external customs brokers and customs authorities. This position requires strong knowledge of EU customs regulations, BAFA export controls, Switzerland trade requirements, Intrastat reporting, sanctions programs, trade automation systems and fluency in German and English.

What You Will Do.

Serve as the primary Trade Compliance point of contact for all EU, UK, and Switzerland import and export compliance activities.
Ensure compliance with EU, UK, Swiss, German, and applicable international trade regulations.
Provide trade compliance guidance to internal stakeholders and support operational teams in resolving customs, import/export, and regulatory issues while minimizing business disruption.
Maintain strong relationships with customs brokers, freight forwarders, government authorities, and internal and external partners.
Support customs audits, inquiries, and regulatory reviews conducted by customs authorities.
Monitor and interpret regulatory changes impacting EU, UK, and Switzerland trade operations and implement necessary compliance controls.
Develop and maintain trade compliance procedures, work instructions, and internal controls.
Determine and maintain Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HTS/TARIC/Swiss Customs Tariff) and Export Control Classification Number (ECCN) classifications for products, components, spare parts, machinery, and materials within the Semiconductor Manufacturing Equipment (SME) industry, utilizing Agile Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), engineering specifications, technical documentation, and applicable regulatory resources to ensure classification accuracy and compliance.
Research customs rulings and regulatory guidance to support classification decisions.
Resolve Oracle OTM/GTM trade compliance holds related to HTS/TARIC/CH classifications, ECCNs, country of origin, customs valuation information, end-user records, and licensing data.
Manage and maintain all EU, UK, German, and Swiss export licenses and authorizations, including license applications, renewals, reporting obligations, utilization monitoring, and recordkeeping to ensure ongoing regulatory compliance.
Serve as the subject matter expert for BAFA export control requirements and systems, administering BAFA portal activities and supporting licensing determinations.
Document compliance determinations and maintain auditable records.
Own and support Intrastat reporting activities by validating customs and trade data, coordinating with Finance, Logistics, and customs brokers to ensure accurate and timely submissions, and supporting audits and other regulatory reporting requirements.
Monitor and implement EU, UK, and Swiss sanctions and trade restriction requirements, including Russian and Belarusian sanctions programs; conduct sanctions reviews, support restricted party screening activities, evaluate transaction compliance risks, and maintain documentation supporting compliance determinations.
Serve as a trade compliance advisor to business stakeholders on sourcing decisions, supply chain changes, STE/TAG assessments, product classification, and export control requirements.
Conduct trade compliance risk assessments, identify compliance gaps and potential regulatory exposures, and implement corrective actions and process improvements.

What You Will Bring.

Bachelor’s degree in international business, Supply Chain, Logistics, Customs, Trade Compliance, Legal Studies, or related field; equivalent experience may be considered.
2+ years of experience in a multinational Trade Compliance environment, customs compliance function, consulting practice, or law firm with a focus on import/export compliance, customs classification, export controls, and sanctions.
Strong verbal and written communication skills in English and German.
Demonstrated experience determining EU, UK, and Swiss HTS/TARIC classifications and export control classifications.
Working knowledge of EU, UK, Swiss, and German import and BAFA export control regulations, and licensing processes.
Experience using trade automation systems such as Oracle OTM/GTM, SAP GTS, Descartes, GTC, or similar trade compliance platforms.
Experience working with customs brokers and supporting EU customs declaration and import/export operations.
Experience managing denied party screening and sanctions compliance reviews.
Experience supporting Intrastat reporting requirements.
Strong analytical skills with proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and data analysis techniques.
Experience in Semiconductor Manufacturing Equipment (SME), industrial manufacturing, or other highly regulated technology-driven industries is preferred but not required.
Ability to communicate complex trade compliance requirements to cross-functional business stakeholders.

What We Offer.

A combined environment that values continuous learning & growth, problem solving, innovation, and teamwork to achieve mutual success.
Employee Referral Program
Mental Health & Wellness Benefits
Continuing education opportunities

jobs.description:
At E Source, we help utilities make sense of complexity in a rapidly changing landscape, and we're looking for a Senior Transmission Planning Consultant to help shape how that impact shows up in the world.

E Source is a research, data/analytics, and technology focused professional services firm focused exclusively on the utility industry in the US and Canada. We help utilities target and serve their customers more effectively, enhance and optimize their grid, and leverage operating best practices and technologies to manage their business more effectively. Headquartered in Texas, we have 450+ employees across the US and Canada. Learn more at www.esource.com

As a Senior Transmission Planning Consultant, you'll lead high-impact studies and consulting engagements for electric utilities, ISOs/RTOs, cooperatives, and other industry stakeholders. You'll oversee and execute advanced transmission planning studies, including transient stability, power flow, transfer capability, reliability, short-circuit, and economic dispatch analysis, to support client decision-making and regulatory compliance, serving as a trusted advisor who engages directly with clients to define objectives, design methodologies, and deliver actionable results. This is a senior, client-facing role that blends deep technical expertise with strong project leadership: the ideal candidate is a seasoned consultant who thrives on solving complex challenges, mentoring teams, and ensuring deliverables meet both technical and business objectives.

In This Role, You Will

Lead and manage transmission planning studies, including stability, power flow, reliability, short-circuit, and congestion management analyses.
Serve as the primary client contact, driving project scope, methodologies, and deliverables.
Provide technical oversight, quality assurance, and guidance to junior engineers and consultants.
Prepare and present detailed technical reports documenting assumptions, methodologies, and results.
Contribute to business development by supporting proposals, client meetings, and thought leadership.
Collaborate with senior leadership to shape service offerings and enhance technical capabilities.
Mentor and train less experienced staff, fostering knowledge transfer and professional development.

You’re Likely a Great Fit If You

Have proven success managing complex technical studies and project teams.
Can navigate challenges, resolve obstacles, and adapt your approach to meet client needs.
Communicate and present clearly, with experience in client-facing consulting roles.
Enjoy training and mentoring junior engineers.
Bring strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and critical thinking.

And Even Better If You

Have experience with Aspen, EasyPower, PSLF, EMTP/ATP, PSCAD, or PROMOD.
Have experience with harmonics analysis.
Are comfortable working independently in a fully remote environment.

Experience And Skills To Qualify Include

B.S. in electrical engineering or a related field; M.S. with 12+ years, Ph.D. with 8+ years, or B.S. with 15+ years of relevant experience in transmission planning, operations, or consulting.
In-depth knowledge of transmission system planning processes, methodologies, and industry practices.
Experience with transient stability, short-circuit, voltage, production costing, TPL compliance, and generator interconnection analysis.
Strong competency in PSS/E (required).
Strong experience with Transmission Adequacy & Reliability Assessment (TARA), including reliability and contingency (N-1) analysis, flowgate analysis, and assessing import/export limits for resource adequacy.
Familiarity with NERC, FERC, and ISO/RTO requirements and processes (for example, PJM, ERCOT, MISO, SPP, CAISO, WECC, SERC, NYISO, or ISO-NE).
Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

At E Source, you’ll work alongside people who are thoughtful, curious, and deeply knowledgeable about utility and energy systems. We value clarity over jargon, substance over flash, and collaboration over ego. You’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills, contribute to meaningful work, and help shape a company that plays a real role in how the energy future unfolds.

A flexible time off (FTO) policy that provides paid time away from work, approved by your manager, while ensuring business needs, workload commitments, and appropriate coverage are maintained.

Job Description

The Role
: As a Senior Customer Success Manager (CSM) at Strategy, you will serve as the primary bridge between our enterprise customers and Strategy's engineering, product, and go-to-market teams. You will own the full post sales lifecycle of a customer account portfolio, ensuring customers do not simply "use" the platform but deeply integrate Strategy's cloud-native architecture, Semantic Layer (Mosaic), and AI-powered analytics capabilities into their core technology stack.

Your goal is to drive measurable business value and Net Revenue Retention (NRR) by ensuring the platform is technically optimized, strategically adopted, and commercially positioned to expand.

Location (Preferred)
: This role is ideally based in the San Francisco Bay Area, CA. Candidates located in the Bay Area are strongly preferred.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Strategy & Customer Success
Act as the lead technical advisor for your accounts, guiding customers through complex cloud-native architectures, Semantic Layer (Mosaic) implementations, and AI-driven analytics workflows.

About Dots

Dots (usedots.com) is a Series A fintech backed by Y Combinator and DCM, building payout infrastructure for marketplaces and digital platforms. In the past year, we have grown our revenues by over 400%, and have built a deep base of loyal customers.

Since our founding 4 years ago, we’ve moved nearly $3 billion per year to more than 1 million payees across 190+ countries, helping businesses onboard, pay and manage recipients around the world.

The role

You'll manage customer onboarding, retention and growth, while also running our full-time and contract support team. You'll carry your own accounts, help customers navigate complex payout issues and decide which recurring problems should be solved through better process, automation or product. You'll own the process of taking customers from signing a contract to going live, and beyond.

You report directly to the founders.

What You'll Do

Onboarding & implementation

Own customers from signed contract through their first successful payouts.
Understand what each customer is trying to build, help them choose the right Dots implementation and coordinate verification, integration, testing and launch.
Keep implementations moving, unblock customers and shorten the path from signature to first transaction.

Retention & growth

Own a portfolio of customers after launch and build strong, ongoing relationships with them.
Identify retention risk early, improve adoption and make sure customers continue getting value from Dots.
Look for opportunities to grow accounts through increased payout volume, additional products or expansion into new parts of a customer's business.

Support

Run our support function, including our full-time and contract support team.
Set a high bar for response quality, escalation and follow-through.
Get technical when something breaks: use our docs, logs and internal tools to understand payout issues before escalating to engineering.

Systems & customer voice

Build the customer success systems we don't have yet: onboarding processes, account-health signals, escalation paths and playbooks.
Identify recurring customer problems and decide what we should automate, document or ask product and engineering to eliminate.
Bring customer feedback, patterns and opportunities back to the founders and product team.

About You

You're comfortable operating without a playbook and excited by the opportunity to build one.

You set a high bar, move quickly and take ownership when something isn't working. You're equally comfortable building relationships with customers, digging into operational problems and pushing internally for changes that make their experience better.

You want meaningful ownership and a team that will challenge your thinking.

What You'll Bring

3+ years in customer success, implementation or account management at a B2B software, fintech company, or marketplace.
Experience owning enterprise onboarding and shortening the path from signature to first transaction.
Experience managing customers after launch, including retention, adoption and account growth.
The ability to build strong customer relationships while still pushing projects forward.
Enough technical fluency to read API docs, dig through logs and investigate why a payout failed before escalating.
Experience building onboarding, customer health or escalation processes from scratch.
The ability and desire to run a support team while carrying your own accounts.

Bonus points if you have

Worked in fintech or finance, ideally in payments or payouts.
Managed a mixed team of full-time employees and contractors.
Scaled support from a shared inbox into a more structured function.

Tools we use

Intercom and Pylon for support
Linear for engineering escalations
Slack and Notion

What We Provide

Private medical insurance, including dental and vision
Unlimited vacation policy
Regular team off-sites
401k plan

The Compliance Analyst serves as the project compliance expert on a wide portfolio of Clark’s government-funded construction projects. The Compliance Analyst will work alongside a dedicated team of highly trained compliance professionals to ensure our projects meet their compliance objectives. This is an entry level role with potential for upward mobility within the Project Controls and Compliance department.

Responsibilities

We value candidates who are highly motivated, customer-focused and open-minded team players ready to dig into a highly collaborative and dynamic environment. While specific job responsibilities will vary based on departments and assignments, rotations and responsibilities may include:

Protect the organization and our trade partners by strictly enforcing compliance with federal, state, and local prevailing wage laws, as well as union and PLA requirements
Generate, certify, and submit all Clark craft employee Certified Payroll Reports (CPRs), as well as subcontractor CPRs timely and accurately
Manage all prevailing wage related document collection and review for Clark and our trade partners
Perform detailed cross-checks of payroll submissions against other project documents to ensure proper payment of wages to all craft workers
Collaborate with both project team and corporate leadership on process improvements and issue resolution related to project compliance
Assists with complex prevailing wage issues and/or investigations with third parties
Maintain confidentiality and compliance with access around sensitive information
Create economic opportunity within the communities we work by ensuring Clark and our trade partners meet all goals around worker utilization and small business subcontracting
Quickly resolve all internal audit report findings
Manage project start-up and close-out for compliance
Performs other compliance related duties as required
Travel required to one or more project sites locally
Conduct worker interviews on site on a weekly basis to ensure compliance with prevailing wage laws

Basic Qualifications

Highly motivated individual with strong organizational and time management skills
Careful attention to detail and reliability of output
Ability to learn quickly and work under pressure in a fast-paced team environment
Excellent oral and written communication skills
Familiarity with federal contracting, labor regulations, and FAR regulations a plus
Alignment to Clark Standards of Excellence: Self-Motivated, Results Oriented, Adaptable, Team Player, Accountable, Ethical, Innovative, Resilient, Builds Relationships, Builds People / Teams and Followership, Sets Direction and Executes

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) preferred, or similar relevant work experience

The work environment and requirements described below are representative of those necessary for an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this role.

The Physical Side of the Role:
A good portion of your day will be spent at a desk, so you should be comfortable with prolonged sitting while working on a computer, handling documents, or participating in meetings. The role requires the ability to communicate effectively, as well as visual acuity for reviewing documents and performing computer work. You'll also need to be able to move around the office and travel occasionally to various locations, including construction sites, using different modes of transportation. You should be able to lift and move objects up to 10 pounds regularly, and up to 25 pounds on occasion (think a box of files or small office equipment).

Your Work Environment:
Your primary workspace will be in our professional office, which has a typical, quiet-to-moderate noise and light levels. As part of your work, you may also be required to visit active construction sites. These environments are naturally more dynamic and can include exposure to outdoor weather conditions, louder noise, and moving equipment. Your safety is our top priority, and you'll be expected to follow Clark Construction's safety policies and procedures, and all applicable laws, at all locations.

Our High-Performing Culture
: This is a demanding, high-performance environment. We are looking for candidates who are energized by challenge, thrive under pressure, and are prepared to do what it takes to achieve exceptional results. Success in this role requires significant commitment, including flexibility to work extended hours, especially during critical project phases or client deadlines.

A Drug Free Workplace
: Clark promotes a drug free workplace. A pre-employment fitness for duty screening is required, and random fitness for duty tests of employees are conducted quarterly.

Clark offers a total compensation package that includes base salary, bonus potential, and a comprehensive benefits package including health/dental/vision benefits, paid time off, retirement/401k, and Company Contribution plan. Additional benefits include life insurance, commuter benefit, short & long term disability, fitness reimbursement, FSA, tuition reimbursement, back-up daycare, tutoring & family support benefits, EAP/Work-Life assistance, and a holiday contribution program. For this role the base salary range is $60,0000-$75,000. Compensation may vary outside of this range depending on a number of factors, including a candidate’s education, experience, skills, and geographic location. Base pay is one part of the Total Compensation Package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work.

jobs.description:
We are adding to our diverse team of experts and are looking to hire those who are committed to building a culture that enables the creation of innovative solutions for our business units and clients.

The Company

Munich Re America Services (MRAS) is a shared service organization that delivers services to all Munich Re US P&C Companies and other group entities.

As a member of Munich Re's US operations, we offer the financial strength and stability that comes with being part of the world's preeminent insurance and reinsurance brand. Our risk experts work together to assemble the right mix of products and services to help our clients stay competitive – from traditional reinsurance coverages, to niche and specialty reinsurance and insurance products.

The Opportunity

Future focused and always one step ahead!

Digital solutions and digital platforms are the key drivers for future growth. The Realytix Zero is a worldwide scalable Automated Underwriting Technology Platform comprising of rules and pricing engines to digitize & automate the underwriting of single risk business based on self-configuration for our business owners. The highly motivated team consists of colleagues with a broad range of know how – Underwriters, IT Developers, Pricing experts, Actuaries, IT Platform Architects and Data Engineers apply agile methodologies.

The Realytix team was built in the German headquarter in Munich and has grown further internationally in US. The Customer Success Manager is expected to assure and support high quality product implementation including analysis & reporting and support the execution of market strategies to fortify the overall product strategy in the North American region. This role will consult with our internal and external clients in the digitization of new or existing insurance or reinsurance products. The incumbent will support the business development and gather requirements for new platform features from the business and client perspective. The individual is expected to be able to influence technological platform developments and communicate those actively both internally and externally.

Responsibilities

Lead the development and continuous enhancement of the US customer success strategy, ensuring alignment with business goals and client expectations.
Own end-to-end client onboarding, including discovery workshops, requirements capture, solution design, platform configuration, UAT coordination, go-live readiness, and post-launch stabilization.
Establish and maintain proactive mechanisms for monitoring customer satisfaction, identifying trends, and implementing data-driven improvements.

Independently manage and deliver complex implementation projects, from PoC workshops through full deployment, ensuring superior client experience and timely execution across multiple stakeholders.

Identify and pursue strategic business opportunities with existing clients, acting as a key relationship manager across internal and external stakeholders (Insurers, MGAs, Munich Re Group Companies).
Lead initiatives to digitize underwriting workflows by translating business rules, pricing logic, and operational requirements into scalable platform configurations and implementation plans.

Collaborate with Business Development (BD) Managers to co-develop tailored client value propositions, taking ownership of sales pitch preparation and delivery, and driving client engagement strategies.
Serve as a strategic advisor to clients during implementation and operational phases, proactively identifying opportunities to scale business volume and improve platform utilization.
Monitor and analyze the effectiveness of sales strategies, providing actionable insights and recommendations to BD Managers based on implementation outcomes and client feedback.
Demonstrate deep understanding of platform capabilities, bridging business and technology perspectives to influence platform development and innovation.
Actively lead cross-functional collaboration with client teams (e.g., Underwriting, Actuarial, Contract Writers), supporting BD strategy execution and contributing to the success of the Americas Team.
Facilitate knowledge exchange with innovation and product development teams across the Munich Re ecosystem to bring forward relevant solutions.

Champion client-centric feature development, acting as the voice of US customers within the broader Realytix Customer Success Team and influencing product roadmap decisions.
Work directly with engineering and client IT teams on technical topics such as API requirements, data mapping, configuration logic, defect triage, release readiness, and production issue resolution.

Qualifications

Successful candidates will possess the following skills/capabilities:

Understanding of underwriting principles in Non-Life (treaty or facultative) to understand product concepts for Digital & Automated Underwriting
5+ years of relevant experience in Underwriting, Software Development, Project Management skills within the insurance, InsurTech or a similar technical delivery role.
Working knowledge and solid understanding of different insurance or reinsurance pricing approaches and components.
Prior experience in software development, QA, solutions architecture, implementation engineering, or a similar technical delivery role.
Experience translating business requirements into technical specifications and platform configurations
Experience working with APIs, data mapping, integration requirements, and testing
Ability to troubleshoot complex implementation issues with engineering and client IT teams
Experience with SaaS platforms, workflow systems, or rules/pricing engines
Self-starter with a strong bias for action and ability to manage competing priorities
Excellent networking, communication, influencing without authority and stakeholder management skills
Customer-service and relationship-oriented.
Familiarity and interest with the technology space and IT platforms
Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent work experience preferred
Willingness to work with teams distributed across different time zones and continents
Willingness to travel around 10%

The Company is open to considering candidates in New York City, NY. The salary range posted below applies to the Company’s NYC location.

The base salary range anticipated for this position is $115,600- $169,500
plus opportunity for company bonus based upon a percentage of eligible pay. In addition, the company makes available a variety of benefits to employees, including health insurance coverage, an employee wellness program, life and disability insurance, 401k match, retirement savings plan, paid holidays and paid time off (PTO).

Job Description

Brooks is seeking a highly experienced Senior Trade Compliance Analyst (m/f/d)
based onsite in our Steisslingen or Tagerwilen office, to serve as the regional trade compliance expert for European Union (EU), United Kingdom (UK), and Switzerland (CH). This role is responsible for managing import and export compliance operations, customs classification, licensing, denied party screening, sanctions compliance, customs broker management, and trade system administration across the region.

The Senior Trade Compliance Analyst will act as the primary point of contact for EU/UK trade compliance matters, partnering closely with internal stakeholders, and external customs brokers and customs authorities. This position requires strong knowledge of EU customs regulations, BAFA export controls, Switzerland trade requirements, Intrastat reporting, sanctions programs, trade automation systems and fluency in German and English.

What You Will Do.

Serve as the primary Trade Compliance point of contact for all EU, UK, and Switzerland import and export compliance activities.
Ensure compliance with EU, UK, Swiss, German, and applicable international trade regulations.
Provide trade compliance guidance to internal stakeholders and support operational teams in resolving customs, import/export, and regulatory issues while minimizing business disruption.
Maintain strong relationships with customs brokers, freight forwarders, government authorities, and internal and external partners.
Support customs audits, inquiries, and regulatory reviews conducted by customs authorities.
Monitor and interpret regulatory changes impacting EU, UK, and Switzerland trade operations and implement necessary compliance controls.
Develop and maintain trade compliance procedures, work instructions, and internal controls.
Determine and maintain Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HTS/TARIC/Swiss Customs Tariff) and Export Control Classification Number (ECCN) classifications for products, components, spare parts, machinery, and materials within the Semiconductor Manufacturing Equipment (SME) industry, utilizing Agile Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), engineering specifications, technical documentation, and applicable regulatory resources to ensure classification accuracy and compliance.
Research customs rulings and regulatory guidance to support classification decisions.
Resolve Oracle OTM/GTM trade compliance holds related to HTS/TARIC/CH classifications, ECCNs, country of origin, customs valuation information, end-user records, and licensing data.
Manage and maintain all EU, UK, German, and Swiss export licenses and authorizations, including license applications, renewals, reporting obligations, utilization monitoring, and recordkeeping to ensure ongoing regulatory compliance.
Serve as the subject matter expert for BAFA export control requirements and systems, administering BAFA portal activities and supporting licensing determinations.
Document compliance determinations and maintain auditable records.
Own and support Intrastat reporting activities by validating customs and trade data, coordinating with Finance, Logistics, and customs brokers to ensure accurate and timely submissions, and supporting audits and other regulatory reporting requirements.
Monitor and implement EU, UK, and Swiss sanctions and trade restriction requirements, including Russian and Belarusian sanctions programs; conduct sanctions reviews, support restricted party screening activities, evaluate transaction compliance risks, and maintain documentation supporting compliance determinations.
Serve as a trade compliance advisor to business stakeholders on sourcing decisions, supply chain changes, STE/TAG assessments, product classification, and export control requirements.
Conduct trade compliance risk assessments, identify compliance gaps and potential regulatory exposures, and implement corrective actions and process improvements.

What You Will Bring.

Bachelor’s degree in international business, Supply Chain, Logistics, Customs, Trade Compliance, Legal Studies, or related field; equivalent experience may be considered.
2+ years of experience in a multinational Trade Compliance environment, customs compliance function, consulting practice, or law firm with a focus on import/export compliance, customs classification, export controls, and sanctions.
Strong verbal and written communication skills in English and German.
Demonstrated experience determining EU, UK, and Swiss HTS/TARIC classifications and export control classifications.
Working knowledge of EU, UK, Swiss, and German import and BAFA export control regulations, and licensing processes.
Experience using trade automation systems such as Oracle OTM/GTM, SAP GTS, Descartes, GTC, or similar trade compliance platforms.
Experience working with customs brokers and supporting EU customs declaration and import/export operations.
Experience managing denied party screening and sanctions compliance reviews.
Experience supporting Intrastat reporting requirements.
Strong analytical skills with proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and data analysis techniques.
Experience in Semiconductor Manufacturing Equipment (SME), industrial manufacturing, or other highly regulated technology-driven industries is preferred but not required.
Ability to communicate complex trade compliance requirements to cross-functional business stakeholders.

What We Offer.

A combined environment that values continuous learning & growth, problem solving, innovation, and teamwork to achieve mutual success.

Continuing education opportunities

At E Source, we help utilities make sense of complexity in a rapidly changing landscape, and we're looking for a Senior Transmission Planning Consultant to help shape how that impact shows up in the world.

E Source is a research, data/analytics, and technology focused professional services firm focused exclusively on the utility industry in the US and Canada. We help utilities target and serve their customers more effectively, enhance and optimize their grid, and leverage operating best practices and technologies to manage their business more effectively. Headquartered in Texas, we have 450+ employees across the US and Canada. Learn more at www.esource.com

As a Senior Transmission Planning Consultant, you'll lead high-impact studies and consulting engagements for electric utilities, ISOs/RTOs, cooperatives, and other industry stakeholders. You'll oversee and execute advanced transmission planning studies, including transient stability, power flow, transfer capability, reliability, short-circuit, and economic dispatch analysis, to support client decision-making and regulatory compliance, serving as a trusted advisor who engages directly with clients to define objectives, design methodologies, and deliver actionable results. This is a senior, client-facing role that blends deep technical expertise with strong project leadership: the ideal candidate is a seasoned consultant who thrives on solving complex challenges, mentoring teams, and ensuring deliverables meet both technical and business objectives.

In This Role, You Will

Lead and manage transmission planning studies, including stability, power flow, reliability, short-circuit, and congestion management analyses.
Serve as the primary client contact, driving project scope, methodologies, and deliverables.
Provide technical oversight, quality assurance, and guidance to junior engineers and consultants.
Prepare and present detailed technical reports documenting assumptions, methodologies, and results.
Contribute to business development by supporting proposals, client meetings, and thought leadership.
Collaborate with senior leadership to shape service offerings and enhance technical capabilities.
Mentor and train less experienced staff, fostering knowledge transfer and professional development.

You’re Likely a Great Fit If You

: As a Senior Customer Success Manager (CSM) at Strategy, you will serve as the primary bridge between our enterprise customers and Strategy's engineering, product, and go-to-market teams. Dots (usedots.com) is a Series A fintech backed by Y Combinator and DCM, building payout infrastructure for marketplaces and digital platforms. In the past year, we have grown our revenues by over 400%, and have built a deep base of loyal customers.

Since our founding 4 years ago, we’ve moved nearly $3 billion per year to more than 1 million payees across 190+ countries, helping businesses onboard, pay and manage recipients around the world.

The role

You'll manage customer onboarding, retention and growth, while also running our full-time and contract support team. You'll carry your own accounts, help customers navigate complex payout issues and decide which recurring problems should be solved through better process, automation or product. You'll own the process of taking customers from signing a contract to going live, and beyond.

You report directly to the founders.

What You'll Do

Onboarding & implementation

Own customers from signed contract through their first successful payouts.
Understand what each customer is trying to build, help them choose the right Dots implementation and coordinate verification, integration, testing and launch.
Keep implementations moving, unblock customers and shorten the path from signature to first transaction.

Retention & growth

Own a portfolio of customers after launch and build strong, ongoing relationships with them.
Identify retention risk early, improve adoption and make sure customers continue getting value from Dots.
Look for opportunities to grow accounts through increased payout volume, additional products or expansion into new parts of a customer's business.

Support

Run our support function, including our full-time and contract support team.
Set a high bar for response quality, escalation and follow-through.
Get technical when something breaks: use our docs, logs and internal tools to understand payout issues before escalating to engineering.

Systems & customer voice

Build the customer success systems we don't have yet: onboarding processes, account-health signals, escalation paths and playbooks.
Identify recurring customer problems and decide what we should automate, document or ask product and engineering to eliminate.
Bring customer feedback, patterns and opportunities back to the founders and product team.

You're comfortable operating without a playbook and excited by the opportunity to build one.

You want meaningful ownership and a team that will challenge your thinking.

Experience building onboarding, customer health or escalation processes from scratch.
The ability and desire to run a support team while carrying your own accounts.

Worked in fintech or finance, ideally in payments or payouts.
Managed a mixed team of full-time employees and contractors.
Scaled support from a shared inbox into a more structured function.

Slack and Notion

Position Information

Join the Department of Health Services as a Health Care Compliance Analyst and help support the mission and values of the department!

Starting salary up to $75.12/hour ($156,784/year) and a competitive total compensation package!*

Important note:
The person selected for this position must currently possess, or obtain within the probationary period of this position (generally one year), a valid California license, registration, or certification in a health discipline, and maintain the license, registration, or certification while in the job classification. Please see below for a list of currently approved licensures, registrations, and certifications.

About The Position

The Health Care Compliance Analyst is an integral position within the Department of Health Services that directly supports the promotion of a culture of honest and responsible behavior in compliance with department protocols, policies, and professional standards. This position works closely with management in all of the Health Services divisions to ensure compliance with applicable laws, regulations, policies, grants, and contracts. Other responsibilities include:

Researching, interpreting, and implementing federal, state, and local health regulations and mandates
Conducting compliance audits and investigations to follow up on alleged misconduct
Supporting the administration of the compliance and ethics program, and participating as a member of the Compliance Program Governance Oversight Committee
Tracking reported compliance issues and inquiries and assisting with compliance program risk assessments
Developing health care compliance policies, procedures, and standards of conduct, and providing related training and education to staff

As the ideal candidate for this position, you will have exceptional analytical skills and possess many of the following:

Experience related to health care compliance and an understanding of the seven nationally recognized elements of an effective compliance program
A Health Care Compliance or a Healthcare Privacy Compliance certificate is strongly desired
The ability to research, interpret, and implement federal, state, and local regulatory mandates across the department divisions
A demonstration of integrity, sound judgment, and trustworthiness
Excellent communication skills, including advanced skills in writing and public speaking
Skilled in managing and prioritizing multiple ongoing projects simultaneously and meeting related deadlines
A proven ability to be adaptable and self-directed, while researching and analyzing issues

Please note
that this position is expected to be on-site, in-office work for the first 6 to 12 months. After this initial period, the department will evaluate hybrid telework eligibility and may consider it based on assignment needs, department operations, and performance.

Certified in Health Care Compliance (CHC)
Certified in Healthcare Privacy Compliance (CHPC)
Board Certified in Health Care Management
Certified Professional in Healthcare Quality (CPHQ)
Alcohol and Other Drugs Registration/Certification
Doctor of Medicine
Doctor of Psychology
Associate Social Worker/Licensed Clinical Social Worker
Associate Professional Clinical Counselor/Licensed Professional Clinical Counselor
Associate Marriage and Family Therapist/Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist
Licensed Vocational Nurse
Nurse Practitioner
Physician Assistant
Psychiatric Technician
Registered Nurse
Registered Health Information Administrator (through the American Health Information Management Association)
Other valid California license, registration, or certification in an approved health discipline

Working at the County of Sonoma offers expansive opportunities for growth and development, the ability to be a part of a challenging and rewarding work environment, and the satisfaction of knowing you're working to better our communities. Retirement - A pension fully integrated with Social Security
Incentive Retirement Savings Plan (IRSP) and 457 Voluntary Deferred Compensation - 3% of salary County contribution to a 401(a), in addition to the County matching up to 1% of base salary in 401(a), based upon employee contribution
Paid Parental Leave - May be eligible for up to 8 weeks (320 hours) after 12 months of County employment
Additional Benefits - Excellent dental, vision, disability, life insurance, employee assistance program, professional development, and more
Student Loan Debt Relief - County employees may be eligible for Public Service Loan Forgiveness through the U.S. Department of Education

The Compliance Analyst serves as the project compliance expert on a wide portfolio of Clark’s government-funded construction projects. The Compliance Analyst will work alongside a dedicated team of highly trained compliance professionals to ensure our projects meet their compliance objectives. This is an entry level role with potential for upward mobility within the Project Controls and Compliance department.

Responsibilities

We value candidates who are highly motivated, customer-focused and open-minded team players ready to dig into a highly collaborative and dynamic environment. While specific job responsibilities will vary based on departments and assignments, rotations and responsibilities may include:

Protect the organization and our trade partners by strictly enforcing compliance with federal, state, and local prevailing wage laws, as well as union and PLA requirements
Generate, certify, and submit all Clark craft employee Certified Payroll Reports (CPRs), as well as subcontractor CPRs timely and accurately
Manage all prevailing wage related document collection and review for Clark and our trade partners
Perform detailed cross-checks of payroll submissions against other project documents to ensure proper payment of wages to all craft workers
Collaborate with both project team and corporate leadership on process improvements and issue resolution related to project compliance
Assists with complex prevailing wage issues and/or investigations with third parties
Maintain confidentiality and compliance with access around sensitive information
Create economic opportunity within the communities we work by ensuring Clark and our trade partners meet all goals around worker utilization and small business subcontracting
Quickly resolve all internal audit report findings
Manage project start-up and close-out for compliance
Performs other compliance related duties as required
Travel required to one or more project sites locally
Conduct worker interviews on site on a weekly basis to ensure compliance with prevailing wage laws

Basic Qualifications

Highly motivated individual with strong organizational and time management skills
Careful attention to detail and reliability of output
Ability to learn quickly and work under pressure in a fast-paced team environment
Excellent oral and written communication skills
Familiarity with federal contracting, labor regulations, and FAR regulations a plus
Alignment to Clark Standards of Excellence: Self-Motivated, Results Oriented, Adaptable, Team Player, Accountable, Ethical, Innovative, Resilient, Builds Relationships, Builds People / Teams and Followership, Sets Direction and Executes

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) preferred, or similar relevant work experience

The work environment and requirements described below are representative of those necessary for an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this role.

The Physical Side of the Role:
A good portion of your day will be spent at a desk, so you should be comfortable with prolonged sitting while working on a computer, handling documents, or participating in meetings. The role requires the ability to communicate effectively, as well as visual acuity for reviewing documents and performing computer work. You'll also need to be able to move around the office and travel occasionally to various locations, including construction sites, using different modes of transportation. You should be able to lift and move objects up to 10 pounds regularly, and up to 25 pounds on occasion (think a box of files or small office equipment).

Your Work Environment:
Your primary workspace will be in our professional office, which has a typical, quiet-to-moderate noise and light levels. As part of your work, you may also be required to visit active construction sites. These environments are naturally more dynamic and can include exposure to outdoor weather conditions, louder noise, and moving equipment. Your safety is our top priority, and you'll be expected to follow Clark Construction's safety policies and procedures, and all applicable laws, at all locations.

Our High-Performing Culture
: This is a demanding, high-performance environment. We are looking for candidates who are energized by challenge, thrive under pressure, and are prepared to do what it takes to achieve exceptional results. Success in this role requires significant commitment, including flexibility to work extended hours, especially during critical project phases or client deadlines.

A Drug Free Workplace
: Clark promotes a drug free workplace. A pre-employment fitness for duty screening is required, and random fitness for duty tests of employees are conducted quarterly.

Clark offers a total compensation package that includes base salary, bonus potential, and a comprehensive benefits package including health/dental/vision benefits, paid time off, retirement/401k, and Company Contribution plan. Additional benefits include life insurance, commuter benefit, short & long term disability, fitness reimbursement, FSA, tuition reimbursement, back-up daycare, tutoring & family support benefits, EAP/Work-Life assistance, and a holiday contribution program. For this role the base salary range is $60,0000-$75,000. Compensation may vary outside of this range depending on a number of factors, including a candidate’s education, experience, skills, and geographic location. Base pay is one part of the Total Compensation Package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work.

new_jobs.description:
We are adding to our diverse team of experts and are looking to hire those who are committed to building a culture that enables the creation of innovative solutions for our business units and clients.

The Company

Munich Re America Services (MRAS) is a shared service organization that delivers services to all Munich Re US P&C Companies and other group entities.

As a member of Munich Re's US operations, we offer the financial strength and stability that comes with being part of the world's preeminent insurance and reinsurance brand. Our risk experts work together to assemble the right mix of products and services to help our clients stay competitive – from traditional reinsurance coverages, to niche and specialty reinsurance and insurance products.

The Opportunity

Future focused and always one step ahead!

Digital solutions and digital platforms are the key drivers for future growth. The Realytix Zero is a worldwide scalable Automated Underwriting Technology Platform comprising of rules and pricing engines to digitize & automate the underwriting of single risk business based on self-configuration for our business owners. The highly motivated team consists of colleagues with a broad range of know how – Underwriters, IT Developers, Pricing experts, Actuaries, IT Platform Architects and Data Engineers apply agile methodologies.

The Realytix team was built in the German headquarter in Munich and has grown further internationally in US. The Customer Success Manager is expected to assure and support high quality product implementation including analysis & reporting and support the execution of market strategies to fortify the overall product strategy in the North American region. This role will consult with our internal and external clients in the digitization of new or existing insurance or reinsurance products. The incumbent will support the business development and gather requirements for new platform features from the business and client perspective. The individual is expected to be able to influence technological platform developments and communicate those actively both internally and externally.

Responsibilities

Lead the development and continuous enhancement of the US customer success strategy, ensuring alignment with business goals and client expectations.
Own end-to-end client onboarding, including discovery workshops, requirements capture, solution design, platform configuration, UAT coordination, go-live readiness, and post-launch stabilization.
Establish and maintain proactive mechanisms for monitoring customer satisfaction, identifying trends, and implementing data-driven improvements.

Independently manage and deliver complex implementation projects, from PoC workshops through full deployment, ensuring superior client experience and timely execution across multiple stakeholders.

Identify and pursue strategic business opportunities with existing clients, acting as a key relationship manager across internal and external stakeholders (Insurers, MGAs, Munich Re Group Companies).
Lead initiatives to digitize underwriting workflows by translating business rules, pricing logic, and operational requirements into scalable platform configurations and implementation plans.

Collaborate with Business Development (BD) Managers to co-develop tailored client value propositions, taking ownership of sales pitch preparation and delivery, and driving client engagement strategies.
Serve as a strategic advisor to clients during implementation and operational phases, proactively identifying opportunities to scale business volume and improve platform utilization.
Monitor and analyze the effectiveness of sales strategies, providing actionable insights and recommendations to BD Managers based on implementation outcomes and client feedback.
Demonstrate deep understanding of platform capabilities, bridging business and technology perspectives to influence platform development and innovation.
Actively lead cross-functional collaboration with client teams (e.g., Underwriting, Actuarial, Contract Writers), supporting BD strategy execution and contributing to the success of the Americas Team.
Facilitate knowledge exchange with innovation and product development teams across the Munich Re ecosystem to bring forward relevant solutions.

Champion client-centric feature development, acting as the voice of US customers within the broader Realytix Customer Success Team and influencing product roadmap decisions.
Work directly with engineering and client IT teams on technical topics such as API requirements, data mapping, configuration logic, defect triage, release readiness, and production issue resolution.

Qualifications

Successful candidates will possess the following skills/capabilities:

Understanding of underwriting principles in Non-Life (treaty or facultative) to understand product concepts for Digital & Automated Underwriting
5+ years of relevant experience in Underwriting, Software Development, Project Management skills within the insurance, InsurTech or a similar technical delivery role.
Working knowledge and solid understanding of different insurance or reinsurance pricing approaches and components.
Prior experience in software development, QA, solutions architecture, implementation engineering, or a similar technical delivery role.
Experience translating business requirements into technical specifications and platform configurations
Experience working with APIs, data mapping, integration requirements, and testing
Ability to troubleshoot complex implementation issues with engineering and client IT teams
Experience with SaaS platforms, workflow systems, or rules/pricing engines
Self-starter with a strong bias for action and ability to manage competing priorities
Excellent networking, communication, influencing without authority and stakeholder management skills
Customer-service and relationship-oriented.
Familiarity and interest with the technology space and IT platforms
Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent work experience preferred
Willingness to work with teams distributed across different time zones and continents
Willingness to travel around 10%

The Company is open to considering candidates in New York City, NY. The salary range posted below applies to the Company’s NYC location.

The base salary range anticipated for this position is $115,600- $169,500
plus opportunity for company bonus based upon a percentage of eligible pay. In addition, the company makes available a variety of benefits to employees, including health insurance coverage, an employee wellness program, life and disability insurance, 401k match, retirement savings plan, paid holidays and paid time off (PTO).
